data.name: Settings_ControllerDatabaseDesc
data.value: Abhi update karo GitHub se, ya Aur ke niche set karaa address se, community controller database (SDL_GameControllerDB) download kare hai, aur settings file me uu mapping rakhe hai jon PadForge ke ii version me nai hai. Uu turant use me hai. Dusra address se ii khali naya mapping rakhe hai. Naya mapping khali uu controller ke liye use hoi jiske aur koi gamepad jaisan nai padhe, jon assign nai hai aur jon Force Raw Joystick Mode me nai hai. Reset sab download karaa mapping hataawe hai aur GitHub se phir download kare hai. Aap ke apan row, Aur ke niche, rahi.
